# PrepEve

> PrepEve is an online coaching company for IELTS (Academic and General Training), PTE, CELPIP and French for Canada PR, for learners in India and Canada. Classes are live online, with trainer-marked writing and 1-on-1 speaking practice. 15,000+ students trained; rated 4.7 on Google from 300+ reviews.

Key facts:
- Format: live online classes; also 1-on-1 mentorship and a self-paced course.
- Fees: Self-Paced ₹4,999. Live Coaching and 1-on-1 Mentorship fees are shared on request on WhatsApp.
- Free options: a free live demo class with a level check, and a free 60-minute live IELTS webinar on Saturdays and Sundays at 7:00 PM IST.
- Founder: Sanjita, trainer with over 8 years of experience and a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC). Trainers: Lesancy Sharma (master trainer) and Khushpreet.
- French for Canada PR: live online classes towards NCLC 7 for TEF Canada and TCF Canada. Every class is recorded, and timings suit learners in India and Canada. 6,000+ students taught French.
- Refunds: a full refund within 3 days of payment, if you have attended no more than one live class (for Self-Paced, watched no more than one recorded lecture). See the refund policy.
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 98777 14284 · YouTube @prepeveclasses · https://www.prepeve.com
- PrepEve guides are general information. IRCC, IDP and other official bodies set the rules and decide applications.
